Jo Park: Hey SREs — Havenbrook (tenant_hbk) started seeing p99 regressions on /v1/embeddings ~2026-03-03 08:15 UTC. p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~2.4s, p95 ~700ms. Some customer requests are hitting client timeouts (10s). They provided traces and sample request ids r_20260303_01, r_20260303_02. They’re on Dedicated (pool=d-4-gpu-1). Any immediate triage suggestions? :eyes:
Samir: on it. can you paste one of the trace ids + request payload size? any deploys in last 12h?
Jo Park: trace r_20260303_01. payload ~1k tokens, batch_size=16. No deploys in last 12h. The trace shows ~1.8s queue wait in embed-queue then ~200ms compute. looks like queuing/backpressure, maybe noisy neighbor or large batch storm.
Lina: pulling metrics now — queue_length for d-4-gpu-1 has short bursts aligning with the p99 spikes. Per-tenant backlog shows tenant_hbk and tenant_zeta are top of wait_ms.
Samir: quick query I ran: `SELECT tenant_id, avg(wait_ms) as avg_wait FROM queue_metrics WHERE pool='d-4-gpu-1' AND ts > now()-15m GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY avg_wait DESC LIMIT 5;`
```
tenant_zeta 1700
tenant_hbk 1500
tenant_omicron 120
tenant_alpha 90
tenant_beta 60
```
Kyle: that looks like tenant_zeta & tenant_hbk are causing backlog. Can we do a temporary priority-safe-path for tenant_hbk so their small batches avoid long waits?
Lina: for Dedicated we have a per-tenant override that can change priority weight and max_batch. ops can set `tenant_priority=high` + `max_batch=4` to reduce queue wait for that tenant. That will reduce batching efficiency but helps latency.
Samir: sample admin api call (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/admin/tenants/tenant_hbk/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"priority":"high","max_batch":4,"note":"temp safelist for p99 incident 2965432100"}'
```
Samir: applied override for tenant_hbk at 2026-03-03T08:32:05Z — set priority=high, max_batch=4. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall-bot: Config change applied by Samir at 2026-03-03T08:32:05Z (job 4521).
Jo Park: customer reports immediate improvement — p99 down to ~360ms on their sample traffic, timeouts cleared. They still see occasional ~1s spikes under load.
Kyle: short-term: keep the override until we do a deeper analysis. medium-term: reserve a small dedicated reservation for tenant_hbk during their peak window or shard them off the shared pool. also investigate tenant_zeta hot-keys.
Lina: logs show tenant_zeta sending many large batches around same time; could be a bursty job. recommend we reach out to tenant_zeta CS to see if they can stagger batching, and add tenant_zeta to a throttling rule.
Samir: filing ENG ticket ENG-7891 -> runtime: include traces r_20260303_01/02, queue metrics, and heap of per-tenant batch size histogram. Priority P2. Proposed runtime fixes: per-tenant KV cache partitioning, safeguard max_batch per tenant in the router, and a fast-lane for safelisted tenants.
Jo Park: Customer accepted temporary fix and asked for a quote for a small reserved capacity window (2 GPUs during 07:00-09:00 UTC). I’ll send details. Thanks everyone :pray:
Kyle: reproducible steps for eng:
1) set header `X-Tenant: tenant_hbk`
2) send 4 concurrent requests with `batch_size=16`, ~1k tokens each
3) observe queue_latency > 1s in metrics and traces (embed-queue.wait_ms)
Sample repro curl: `curl -H "X-Tenant: tenant_hbk" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings`
Jo Park: keeping this thread open until ENG-7891 has a plan and reservation quoted. tagging for follow-up: Samir, Lina, Kyle.
Samir: noted. I'll update ticket and owner. :thumbsup:
